about: Hand-written language test cases for app/pipeline/language.py (no LLM, no API cost). expected = nl | en | de for supported languages, or other:<iso> when the customer wrote in a language the helpdesk does not support. Written by the developer, NOT by the detector. Review and set approved=true before relying on the score; the 10 labelled /examples (Nordavo labels) are always scored too.
practice_labels_about: Expected language of the 30 practice tickets (text read from data/tickets.json), written by reading each ticket, not from the detector. none = no text (empty ticket).
